purpose: Prospectively pin the non-code scope, inherited inputs, case geometry, detector definitions, and reporting boundary for a fresh M1--M9 target-gate-suppression comparison.

inherited_rr2_authority.forkaudit_reference_lane: The original RR2 W-run receipt is a separate all-gates-on execution. R28 does not pool it with target-suppressed cases into a rate.

fixed_stack.hardware: 8 distinct NVIDIA H20-3e devices, one original RR2 rank/book per device

case_order_per_fault: fresh matched-clean with all gates enabled
separately rebuilt mutant with only the preregistered target gate suppressed

teacher_forced_continuation_rule.token_source: last token of the corresponding frozen 32-token query

detector_policy.forkaudit_target_gate: read only from the separately frozen RR2 W-run receipt
r28_detectors: other ForkAudit gate after target suppression
allowlisted production assertion with stack provenance
classification_precedence: other ForkAudit gate after target suppression
allowlisted production assertion with exact stack provenance
fault-payload abort with exact preregistered message
detector_policy.unallowlisted_exception_policy: Any exception that is neither a non-target ForkAudit gate, the exact M8 fault-payload abort, nor an exact M7 or M9 production assertion is operational_invalid and cannot count as a detector catch.
detector_policy.missingness: Every unavailable cell remains not_evaluated with null caught/value fields.

semantic_comparison.evaluation_condition: Evaluate only when both matched-clean and target-suppressed lanes complete the entire preregistered horizon.
semantic_comparison.token_caught: true iff the ordered output-token lists differ
semantic_comparison.full_logit_exact_caught: true iff any matched stage has a different SHA-256 over the contiguous raw FP32 logit bytes
semantic_comparison.argmax_equal: true iff argmax indices are identical at every matched stage
semantic_comparison.max_abs: maximum absolute elementwise FP32 logit difference over all matched stages
semantic_comparison.aborted_or_partial_horizon: token and full-logit cells remain not_evaluated; partial sidecars are evidence, not a miss

production_assertion_allowlist.message: vLLM fused backend cannot replace this non-canonical attention mask
fused backend requires paired Q16 paged views

forbidden: convert not_evaluated into false or missed
count generic integration exceptions as production assertions
report designed-fault counts as a population detection rate
pool the RR2 all-gates-on lane with R28 target-suppressed lanes as one execution
claim unseen-fault coverage, independent capture, concurrency, overhead, or runtime generality

code_freeze_rule: The final preregistration must bind the exact policy, runner, builder, replay, test, launcher, QS config, this payload, and scope-supersession hashes before upload or execution.
